# Pull Requests

When creating or updating a pull request:

- Use Conventional Commits format for the title: `<type>(<scope>): <description>`.
- Follow the repository's existing pull request template and contribution guidance.
- If no repository template exists, use Summary, Reason for Change, and Testing sections in the description.
- Use existing repository labels that are appropriate to the changes.

Treat these instructions as defaults. Follow repository-specific guidance where it differs.
